title: VietIRRQAEvaluationRecord
description: Schema for benchmark question-answering evaluation items (e.g., DEV-93, ALL-QA).

qa_id.description: Unique canonical identifier for the benchmark question (e.g. V3_1_CHAL_...).

gold_evidence_ids.description: Fine-grained evidence units / cells containing facts needed for answer.

retrieval_evidence_ids.description: Coarse-grained retrieval units (REG_... or TAB_...) in the corpus index.

location_type.description: Dispersion of evidence required to answer the question.

modality.description: Modality of facts: TEXT, TABLE, or MIXED.

split.description: Benchmark split: dev, test, or train.
